Parametric or sampled time-domain excitation description.

Sign convention: positive ``B``/``H``/voltage follow the right-hand rule around the winding
reference direction stated in ``reference_direction``. Time starts at ``t=0`` at the beginning of
one steady-state period unless ``timebase`` says otherwise.

SteinmetzParameterSet.description:
Classical Steinmetz parameters in SI form: ``Pv [W/m^3] = k * f[Hz]^alpha * Bpk[T]^beta``.

Parameters fitted in other unit systems (kHz, mT, kW/m^3) must be converted on import; the
``original`` field of ``k`` records the pre-conversion value for reproducibility.

k.description: W/m^3 with f in Hz and B in T

temperature.description: temperature at which the set was fitted

SteinmetzParameterSet.title: SteinmetzParameterSet

description: A record of the AIPE Magnetic Data Standard v0.2: a common envelope (identity, evidence, licence, provenance, quality, artifacts with checksums, namespaced extensions) plus a kind-specific 'properties' object bound by the allOf/if/then blocks below. All physical quantities are SI {value, unit} objects; a converted value retains its original {value, unit}. Missing values are omitted, never zero-filled. Large numerical arrays live in HDF5 artifacts described by waveform_dataset records. Generated from the normative pydantic models in aipe_magnetics.data.records - do not edit by hand.
title: AIPE magnetic record v0.2
